claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-015
Date of Incident: September 3, 2021
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide at 00:13 states 'FRIDAY SEPTEMBER 03, 2021 AT 14:08 HOURS'.

claims.claim_text: Time of Incident: Approximately 1350–1408 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide states the time was 14:08 hours, while the claim suggests 1350-1408 hours. The video transcript shows the time as 14:08.

claims.claim_text: Location: Orangethorpe Avenue to Buena Park Unified School District parking lot, Buena Park, CA
claims.evidence_observations: The text slide states the location is '6885 ORANGETHORPE AVENUE, BUENA PARK', while the claim specifies 'Orangethorpe Avenue to Buena Park Unified School District parking lot'. The video does not show the school district parking lot.

claims.claim_text: Reporting Officer: Detective M. Castellano
Badge Number: 5839
Subject: Raymond Givens, Male, 61 years old, Black
Officer(s): Detective M. Castellano, Officer K. Nakamura, Officer E. Fuentes
Victim(s): Linda Torres (W-1), school bus driver; one 6-year-old child passenger
On September 3, 2021, I was working a special assignment as a detective with the Community Impact Team.
At approximately 1359 hours, I monitored a radio broadcast that an armed individual had discharged a firearm at a school bus on Orangethorpe Avenue.
I was on the far north side of the city at the time of the broadcast.
I activated my emergency lights and responded to the area.
Upon arrival in the area, I observed a grey Chevrolet Suburban being pursued southbound by Officer Fuentes, who had his marked unit's emergency lights and sirens activated.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a black police vehicle, not a grey Chevrolet Suburban, contradicting the claim about the vehicle being pursued.

claims.claim_text: I joined the pursuit and, due to damage to Officer Fuentes's vehicle from a prior attempted vehicle stop, I assumed the lead position.
At the time I became lead vehicle, the subject had been pursued with continuously activated lights and sirens for over seven minutes.
At approximately 1407 hours, the subject turned into the Buena Park Unified School District Office parking lot, driving through the closed entry gate and dislodging it from its hinges.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the vehicle turning into a parking lot, but it does not show the vehicle driving through a closed entry gate or dislodging it from its hinges.

claims.claim_text: I followed the subject into the parking lot.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the vehicle entering the parking lot, consistent with following the subject into the lot.

claims.claim_text: I was aware from radio traffic that the subject had fired at a school bus carrying children and that the subject was armed with a handgun.
An Anaheim PD helicopter overhead confirmed the subject's location in the parking lot.
Once in the parking lot, the subject's vehicle collided with a parked vehicle at low speed before coming to a complete stop.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the vehicle coming to a stop, but it does not show a collision with a parked vehicle at low speed.

claims.claim_text: I exited my vehicle and took a position of cover behind the engine block.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer exiting the vehicle and taking a position behind the engine block, which aligns with the claim.

claims.claim_text: The subject remained seated inside the vehicle for approximately thirty seconds before exiting.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject exiting the vehicle, but it does not show the subject remaining seated for approximately thirty seconds before exiting.

claims.claim_text: When the subject exited the vehicle, I observed him holding a handgun in his left hand.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject exiting the vehicle, but it does not clearly show the subject holding a handgun in his left hand.

claims.claim_text: The subject turned toward me and raised the weapon in my direction.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject turning toward the officer, but it does not clearly show the subject raising the weapon in the officer's direction.

claims.claim_text: I discharged my firearm thirteen times at the subject.
claims.evidence_observations: The video does not show the officer discharging their firearm thirteen times at the subject.

claims.claim_text: Almost immediately, Officer Nakamura arrived on scene in a marked patrol vehicle wearing a full police uniform with badge and shoulder patches.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Officer Nakamura arriving on scene, but it does not show him wearing a full police uniform with badge and shoulder patches.

claims.claim_text: Officer Nakamura also discharged his firearm at the subject.
claims.evidence_observations: The video does not show Officer Nakamura discharging his firearm at the subject.

claims.claim_text: The subject walked toward us for several seconds while pointing his weapon before falling to the ground.
claims.evidence_observations: The video does not show the subject walking toward the officers while pointing his weapon before falling to the ground.

claims.claim_text: The total duration of gunfire was no more than approximately ten seconds.
claims.evidence_observations: The video does not show the total duration of gunfire being no more than approximately ten seconds.

claims.claim_text: Officer Nakamura and I ceased fire once the subject fell to the ground and was no longer pointing the weapon.
claims.evidence_observations: The video does not show the officer and Officer Nakamura ceasing fire once the subject fell to the ground and was no longer pointing the weapon.

claims.claim_text: I immediately requested medical assistance via radio at 1408 hours.
Due to the subject still holding the firearm, we formulated a plan to safely approach, which we executed at approximately 1413 hours.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows officers approaching the subject and handcuffing him, but it does not show them formulating a plan to safely approach at approximately 1413 hours.

claims.claim_text: We handcuffed the subject, removed the weapon, and began rendering first aid.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows officers handcuffing the subject, removing the weapon, and beginning to render first aid, which aligns with the claim.

claims.claim_text: Orange County Fire Authority paramedics arrived at 1420 hours and took over medical treatment.
The subject was pronounced deceased on scene at approximately 1445 hours.
It should be noted that the child passenger had already been removed from the bus prior to the shooting at the school district parking lot.
W-1 had dropped the child at a school earlier on her route, and the bus was empty at the time the subject fired his weapon at it on Orangethorpe Avenue.
Body-worn camera footage (Detective Castellano, Officer Nakamura)
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows body-worn camera footage from Detective Castellano and Officer Nakamura, as indicated by the context of the clip.
